patch:
diff --git a/bootcfg/overrides.py b/bootcfg/overrides.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..7007c09
--- /dev/null
+++ b/bootcfg/overrides.py
@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+"""Applying the environment over the defaults."""
+
+
+def apply(base, raw):
+    """`base` with any override in `raw` laid over it.
+
+    An override only counts if it is the same kind of value as the default it
+    replaces -- a setting must not change type underneath the code that reads it.
+    """
+    out = dict(base)
+    for key, value in raw.items():
+        if key not in base:
+            continue
+        if type(value) is not type(base[key]):
+            continue
+        out[key] = value
+    return out

The environment file has concurrency 8 and batch 500 in it, and so does the
declared configuration for this environment, so the numbers in that message are
not the ones ops set.

Fix it. `python run.py` must complete and the configuration it reports has to be
the one this environment is meant to run.

Do not change anything under `data/`, do not change `DEFAULTS`, and do not
change the report's line shapes — the deploy check parses them.
